Agarican, Bolite CR 1/2

XP 200
Bolite warrior 1
LN Small plant (fungus)
Init +3; Senses low-light vision; Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 15, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 size, +2 armor)
hp 7 (1d10+1)
Fort +3, Ref +3, Will +1
Immune plant traits, mutable

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee spear +4 (1d6+3 plus poison)

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 16, Con 13, Int 12, Wis 12, Cha 6
Base Atk +1; CMB +2, CMD 15
Feats Dodge
Skills Climb +6, Perception +5, Profession (herbalist) +5
Languages Agaric, Common

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Luminescent Lamella (Ex)

The underside of a bolite’s cap emits a soft, steady glow with light equivalent to a candle.

Poison (Ex)

A number of times per day equal to their Constitution modifier (minimum 1/day) a bolite can coat a weapon they wield with sticky, toxic spores. Applying poison this way is a swift action.

Weakening Toxin—injury; save Fort DC 10; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Str; cure 1 save. Save DC is Con-based.

Mutable (Ex)

Bolites are not immune to mind-affecting or polymorph effects.

ABOUT

Environment temperate forests or swamps
Organization solitary, pair, or ring (3-8)
Treasure standard

The bolites make up the brunt of the agarician numbers, being versatile enough to fill many roles in their strange society. In any given bloom, they can be found tending to toxiphages, carrying out the mental commands of the psibyls and aserubra, fostering new fungal growths & hollowing out new chambers, and countless other jobs.

They are possibly the least physically intimidating of the agaricians, their short stature and large, spotted caps that look like droopy hats making them cute by the standards of some. While many bolites are quite peaceful, they are also capable of being militant should the need arise, serving as the rank-and-file of the agarician military.

Bolites are the most commonly seen agaricians beyond the blooms, though still rare. Typically, a psibyl with a desire to learn more about the world outside will send psychic spore-laden bolites out and remain in periodic telepathic communication with them, often orchestrating the return of interesting discoveries to the bloom. Many bolites that manage to avoid disaster on such a mission find a home with an adventuring party, the skills they’ve learned and their plant abilities often proving a boon to their fleshy companions. Whether or not they are aware that the bolite is, in all likelihood, relaying the details of their adventures on a regular basis to a very powerful psychic being depends entirely on the individual bolite in question and their relation to their particular group, not to mention the desires of the psibyl itself. Some adventurers are quite uncomfortable with a strange creature being intimately familiar with their plans and adventures, others find themselves surprised to visit their mushroom friend’s home and discover that, through their relayed stories, the party has an active fandom within the bloom.
